mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_VIEW_HISTORY (user_idx, content_type, content_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT h.history_idx, h.content_type, h.content_id, h.viewed_at, CASE h.content_type WHEN 'community' THEN cp.title WHEN 'spot' THEN st.name WHEN 'plan' THEN tp.title ELSE NULL END AS title, CASE h.content_type WHEN 'community' THEN cp.region WHEN 'spot' THEN st.region WHEN 'plan' THEN tp.destination ELSE NULL END AS subtitle, CASE h.content_type WHEN 'community' THEN ( SELECT img.image_url FROM COMMUNITY_POST_IMAGE img WHERE img.post_id = cp.post_id ORDER BY img.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHEN 'spot' THEN ( SELECT si.image_url FROM SPOT_IMAGE si WHERE si.spot_idx = st.spot_idx ORDER BY si.image_idx ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE NULL END AS thumbnail_url, CASE h.content_type WHEN 'community' THEN (cp.post_id IS NOT NULL AND cp.post_status <> 'DELETED') WHEN 'spot' THEN (st.spot_idx IS NOT NULL) WHEN 'plan' THEN (tp.plan_id IS NOT NULL) ELSE FALSE END AS available FROM USER_VIEW_HISTORY h LEFT JOIN COMMUNITY_POST cp ON h.content_type = 'community' AND cp.post_id = h.content_id LEFT JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON h.content_type = 'spot' AND st.spot_idx = h.content_id LEFT JOIN TRAVEL_PLAN tp ON h.content_type = 'plan' AND tp.plan_id = h.content_id WHERE h.user_idx = #{userIdx} ORDER BY h.viewed_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_VIEW_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_VIEW_HISTORY WHERE user_idx = #{userIdx} AND history_idx = #{historyIdx}
